name: Onboard VMs by Name
description: Onboards unmanaged vCenter VMs into a VCF Automation 9.1 project, one deployment per VM (no blueprint). Always stamps the plan with onboardedStatus=true and workflowRun=true; optional extra VM/deployment-level custom properties. dryRun=true builds the plan without executing it.

inputs.name: vmNames
inputs.description: Exact VM names as seen in vCenter

inputs.name: planName
inputs.description: Empty = auto vRO-Onboard-<timestamp>; same name = reuse plan

inputs.name: failOnMissing
inputs.description: Abort if any VM isn't found as unmanaged

inputs.name: dryRun
inputs.description: Build plan + deployments but do not execute

inputs.name: vmCustomProperties
inputs.description: Optional: custom properties set on each onboarded VM

inputs.name: deploymentCustomProperties
inputs.description: Optional: custom properties set on every machine of each onboarded deployment

attributes.name: vcHost
attributes.description: vCenter vcf-m-vc.vmw.lab (inventory connection, for vCenter-side steps)

steps.name: Resolve IDs
Create or reuse plan
Set plan custom properties
Find unmanaged machines
Report dry run
steps.script:
planStatus = "DRY_RUN";
System.log("Dry run: review the plan in Infrastructure > Onboarding, then execute it from the UI or re-run with dryRun=false and a new planName.");

steps.name: Verify deployments
Apply custom properties
